question: Should Crabbox make resolved-SSH copy fallback and a loopback-only `crabbox tunnel` permanent provider-neutral core CLI capabilities?
rationale: The linked reports ask for these capabilities, but the PR introduces a new command and expands the supported `cp` provider matrix; that durable public contract requires maintainer product ownership beyond mechanical review.

options.title: Sponsor the core SSH transport surface
options.body: Confirm the provider-neutral CLI direction, then require the focused review fixes and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep transport features provider-scoped
options.body: Decline the new generic command contract and ask for a provider-specific integration path instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core SSH transport surface
recommendation.body: Confirm the provider-neutral CLI direction, then require the focused review fixes and real behavior proof before merge.
